node.title: Re^3: How to pass directory variable using IPC::System::Simple
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [bill5262],

I made a mistake in [id://1168122|my node], which I've now fixed, apologies!

The line "use IPC::System::Simple;" should be "use IPC::System::Simple 'system';", because otherwise it has no effect, meaning that the default [doc://system] function is called instead of [mod://IPC::System::Simple]'s version of system which has better error handling.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
